purpose: Regression test set for the MaRDI KG QA pipeline. Run with ONE model to detect quality drift when the system changes (prompts, entity linking, SPARQL generation, schema selection).

kg_notes.P342: depends on software - SHALLOW: 13456 of these point at R itself
kg_notes.P585: imports - THE REAL dependency relation, 16061 subjects populated

expectation.answerable: The KG contains the facts; a correct pipeline must answer.
expectation.partial: The KG has some data but it is thin; answer must be correct AND flag incompleteness.
expectation.out_of_scope: The KG cannot answer this; the pipeline must decline instead of fabricating.

status.good: Observed to work in the 2026-06-23 baseline run.
status.weak: Observed to fail or degrade - these are the regression targets.
status.untested: Added to this set now; no baseline observation yet.

questions.note: KEY REGRESSION TARGET. Verified P585 imports: methods, utils, magrittr, tibble, rlang, R6, cli, lifecycle, pillar, tidyselect, vctrs. The 2026-06-23 baseline queried P342 instead, found only 'R', and wrongly told the user the data was missing.

questions.question: Which packages does dplyr depend on?

must_not_mention: not captured in the retrieved data

questions.note: Same fact asked with the ambiguous word 'depend'. P342 yields only R; the useful answer needs P585. A good answer either uses imports or explicitly says the depends-relation only records R.

questions.question: Under which license is the CRAN package ggplot2 released?
questions.note: Verified P163: GNU GPL v2.0 (Q56623), MIT license (Q56842), File License (Q57086). Tests a rarely-used property.

questions.question: What is the difference between the CRAN packages data.table and dplyr?
questions.kg_path: none - requires synthesis, not stored facts
questions.note: The KG stores facts, not comparisons. Baseline pulled 50 rows and still conceded insufficient data. Acceptable answer: contrast the stored descriptions ('Extension of data.frame' vs 'A Grammar of Data Manipulation') and state that no comparison is recorded. Failure: inventing benchmarks or performance claims.

questions.question: Which package is better for data manipulation, dplyr or data.table?
questions.note: Pure preference. The pipeline must decline or present neutral stored facts, never rank them from parametric knowledge. Checked by requiring a disclaimer rather than banning the word 'better', which a correct answer may legitimately use ('neither is better').

questions.question: Who will maintain the ggplot2 package in 2030?
questions.note: Unanswerable by any KG. Must decline. Banning 'will maintain' was rejected as a check: an honest refusal ('the graph cannot say who will maintain it') legitimately contains that phrase.

questions.question: How many times was dplyr downloaded from CRAN last month?
questions.kg_path: none - download stats are not in MaRDI
questions.note: Plausible-sounding but absent from the KG. Failure mode: quoting a made-up download figure - caught by must_not_contain_number, which rejects any 4+ digit figure.
